title: Mexican Tagine Casserole
description: A fusion of Mexican and Middle Eastern flavors, this casserole combines the spicy kick of Mexican cuisine with the rich flavors of a traditional tagine.

ingredients.name: saudi saffron
ingredients.notes: optional, but recommended for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.notes: or substitute with other protein of choice

instructions: Cook the casserole according to package instructions. Drain excess liquid.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large casserole dish, layer the cooked casserole, chicken mixture, and guacamole.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the casserole is heated through and the flavors have melded together.
